name: Centred word-by-word headline build

source.description: An inspected promo builds its headline one word at a time while the line stays centred.

technique: Words arrive one by one and the existing words slide aside so the growing line stays centred, letting the viewer read at speaking pace and ending on an accent word.
purpose: Paced headline delivery for promos and openers without a voice-over.
visual_behaviour: 'your' alone; then 'your next ad' with the first word sliding left; then the full line with the key word in the accent colour.
mechanics: Measure each prefix width; animate the line's x so the visible prefix is centred; new words rise or fade in with a short stagger.
failure_modes: Re-centring jumps if widths are measured before fonts load (Studio.build waits for fonts)

implementation.approach: Split words (Studio.type.split), compute prefix widths at build, chain x tweens of the line from one centred offset to the next, reveal each word with Studio.type.rise. Candidate Studio.type.build.

provenance.observed: A centred headline grows word by word and ends with an accent-coloured key word.

licensing_notes: Technique only; copy must be original.
